findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: There is a small gap at the bottom of the double back door (in back-stock room). The gap appears to be an entryway for rodent activity in the facility. Mice droppings were observed underneath racks, along the perimeter of the walls, and behind and around equipment throughout the backstock room. PIC mentioned that the facility is aware that rodents were present. Ecolab, the facility’s pest control company, normally provides treatment to the building once a month, however, the company has been visiting two to three times a month since November. Ensure that gaps in outer doors are eliminated by sealing entry points to prevent the presence of unwanted insects or rodents.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.citation_text: 6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Floor was observed to be soiled with dried soda splash from a damaged can in the back storage area beneath food awaiting return credit. 
Floor was soiled with dust and general debris under shelving in the back storage area (beneath shelf labeled DRIVELINE).
Ensure floors in the back storage area are cleaned as needed, especially when food/beverage spills occur to avoid attraction of potential pests.
Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean
